tips.text: Crack relics in a full squad of four and take the highest-Ducat reward.
Stockpile 510 Ducats and 175,000 credits before Baro arrives instead of farming once he lands.
Open the relics you already own and sell duplicate Prime parts first; they are the quickest Ducats.
Build any Prime you still need before selling its parts for Ducats; selling first means farming the part again.
Skip Aya for Ducats at Varzia; players call 5 Ducats per Aya terrible.
Nobody complains about the 510 Ducats; the complaints are about it showing up rarely, sometimes months apart.
